title: VAT Rates
description: The VAT rate of each EU member state and the day it applies from. A consumer in another member state is invoiced for digital services at the rate of their own country.
empty: No VAT rates yet. Add a rate, or restart the application to import the rates that ship with it.
noMatches: No VAT rates match your search

deleteModal.title: Delete VAT Rate
deleteModal.message: Delete the {kind} rate of {country} that applies from {validFrom}? Invoices already issued keep the rate they were taxed at.

validFrom.label: Valid from
validFrom.hint: A rate stays in force until a later row of the same country and kind starts. To change a rate, add a row with the new start day.
